title: Refuse a review before reserving an attempt when deterministic checks fail
body:
Outcome: `krn review --pr` runs red-first and the per-commit contract parser before `reserveReviewAttempt`; a non-empty `deterministicCauses` refuses with no ordinal reserved and no judge spawned; docs/program/repository-workflow.md:23 matches.
Evidence: src/flow/index.ts:162-174,218 (at ccac27b); lens-contract-quality Q1; ranked 2 in .krn/runs/program-audit/synthesis.md (8 attempts saved of 13 catchable).
